# EoSim

> llms.txt for the EoSim repository (embeddedos-org/EoSim).
> Status: multi-architecture embedded simulation platform,
> distribution version 3.1.0 (`embeddedos-eosim` on PyPI). Its
> MCP server is registered via the root `server.json`
> (io.github.embeddedos-org/eosim, stdio, `python -m eosim.mcp`).

EoSim simulates EmbeddedOS targets across architectures and
boards (63+ platforms plus QEMU machines): agents and developers
list platforms, launch and flash simulations, read session
status and console output, and inspect captured network traffic
through the CLI or the MCP server. It is also the home of the
org's Agent Skills catalog and the MCP gateway evaluation that
the whole agent fabric will sit behind.
